title: Clean under a car cup-holder liner
instruction: Lift the rubber liner out by its tab, scrub the sticky residue with the sponge, then put the liner back flat in the cup holder.
setup: Fixed automotive centre console with two flared cup wells, brushed trim, padded side bolster and selector surround. A 74 mm rubber liner with pull loop covers nine irregular spill regions in a 94 mm bore. A handled 27 × 23 mm foam pad starts in the utility pocket.
scoring: 0.25 after removing the grasped liner beyond 60 mm in x or 65 mm in y. 0.50 after scrubbing four regions and 0.75 after scrubbing all nine. Scrubbing requires 3 mm of pressure-weighted travel with the pad overlapping the mark under a floor load of at least 0.10 N. 1.00 after the liner is released, aligned and seated for at least 0.35 s.
fidelity: Smooth console skins over compound contact geometry. The residue fades under measured overlapping tool contact and sliding, with simplified compliant materials.
scores: Dream-1: 0.00 (1200 steps). Scripted dual-YAM replay: 1.00 (567 steps). Idle: 0.00. Air wipe: 0.25. Cleaning without refit: 0.75.
